record.paper_title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Complexity of properly coloured Hamilton cycle problem
record.original_question: For c ≥ 3, determine the computational complexity of deciding whether a c-edge-coloured complete graph K_n^c contains a properly coloured Hamilton cycle.

evidence.quote: Problem 6.4 Determine the complexity of the PC Hamilton cycle problem for c-edge-coloured complete graphs when c ≥ 3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let c ≥ 3 be a fixed integer. A c-edge-coloured complete graph on n vertices, denoted K_n^c, is the complete graph K_n together with a map from its edge set to a set of c colours (no properness condition is imposed). A Hamilton cycle in K_n^c is said to be properly coloured if every pair of consecutive edges along the cycle receives distinct colours.

Consider the decision problem:

  PC-HAM(c): Given a c-edge-coloured complete graph K_n^c, decide whether it contains a properly coloured Hamilton cycle.

Determine the computational complexity of PC-HAM(c) for each fixed c ≥ 3. In particular, decide whether PC-HAM(c) is solvable in polynomial time or is NP-complete.
artifact.status_search_result: The complexity of deciding existence of a properly coloured Hamilton cycle in c-edge-coloured complete graphs for c ≥ 3 appears to remain open. The closely related problem for 2-edge-coloured multigraphs is known to be NP-complete, and polynomial-time algorithms are known only in restricted settings (e.g., compatible spanning circuits under stronger structural hypotheses, or asymptotic results based on monochromatic-degree bounds confirming the Bollobás–Erdős conjecture asymptotically). No source found that resolves the complete-graph complexity question for fixed c ≥ 3.

status_evidence.title: Properly coloured Hamiltonian cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs (Combinatorica)
status_evidence.snippet: Asymptotic confirmation of Bollobás–Erdős conjecture on properly coloured Hamilton cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Existence results are known under monochromatic-degree bounds, but these are extremal, not complexity-theoretic, and do not resolve PC-HAM(c).

status_evidence.title: Properly Coloured Cycles and Paths: Results and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing properly coloured cycles/paths in edge-coloured graphs and listing open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The complexity of the PC Hamilton cycle problem for c-edge-coloured complete graphs with c ≥ 3 is posed as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Properly colored cycles in edge-colored complete graphs (2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on properly coloured cycles in edge-coloured complete graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Continued research on existence results; no resolution of the complexity question for c ≥ 3 is cited.
